fact: As of May 2026 the Government of South Sudan, with World Bank support through SNSOP, is preparing to pilot a universal social registry (USR); existing project and humanitarian registries (the World Bank-financed MIS holds 157,000 households, 1.1 percent of the population) use project-specific IDs and are not interoperable, and national ID linkage is planned but not yet in place.
title: Country Diagnostic: South Sudan
